purpose: MIT-focused reference catalog for AgentiCOS Source Forge

policy.rule: A repository being MIT-licensed does not make every dependency or file MIT. Source-level and dependency-level audits remain mandatory before integration.
policy.learning: Registered repositories are implementation references and must be learned through docs, source, tests, build/CI, security and license material before non-trivial features are implemented.
policy.integration: Reference registration does not automatically vendor or copy source into AgentiCOS.
policy.reference_resolution: Named repository first; capability discovery second; exact license/path audit before evidence admission; exact commit pin before integration.
policy.no_invention: No source or architecture claim may be invented when the selected reference corpus does not contain evidence. Missing evidence blocks the implementation step.
policy.full_repo_learning: A selected repository must be inspected as a repository, not from a README excerpt alone: documentation, source tree, tests, build metadata, CI, security, licenses/notices, dependencies and relevant history.
policy.dynamic_discovery: The catalog is a verified seed corpus, not a claim to enumerate every MIT repository on GitHub. New candidates are admitted through the same resolver and audit protocol.
